name: scale numerator and denominator by a common factor that drives the denominator to one
mechanism: multiply both numerator and denominator by the same factor (two minus the denominator) each round; the denominator converges quadratically to one and the numerator to the quotient; the two multiplications per round are independent and can run in parallel

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Goldschmidt division' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions:

requires: a denominator scaled into a fixed interval near one
fails_when: rounding errors accumulate (no self-correction, unlike the reciprocal-refinement route)
